entries.diary_text: Yogesh has been watching porn recently a lot sinse when i said no to m . Recently whenever i go near him he is like so grim and angry .I feel like he doesn't love me like before after this porn came. But what can I do , I don't want to get into m again. My peace of mind also needs to be saved. i feel like we are emotionally very distant now becuase of all things he have been doing. I guess I should become emotionally distant to him because clearly he doesn't like my presence. Whenever I am in meet he is not there he plays a movie and goes away. He gets tensed if he is in meet for half an hour. He gets irritated if I cry no more concern. May your will be done.....

yesterday he was disappointed with me because i didn't do m or any r and left studying in between. today i was telling the three models were different he is just shouting at me for no reason i hate when he shouts at me like that. just losing temper again and again not even able to manage anger. like there is no reason to shout still he keeps shouting and then he is behaving like i am very tough to deal with havinng convo with me is difficult i hate what he does. i am so sad about all that he is doing recently . I never prayed for a lazy and angry man. i prayed for a patient and sweet man. but recently he is shouting a lot. though i try to put myself in his shoes it feels wnfare to me for shouting at me for simple things. i don't like him raising voice. what if he does the same in future i am so tired . :(

today yogesh once again shouted at me. i was watching black widow movie and i was subconsiously tapping the bench i didnt realize he was sleeping ad i am not supposed to tap i am not justifying myself but he all of a sudden shouted at me. this is the second time he shouted at me. but i didn't even do a it wantedly this time. and it hurt. he went outside. he didn't even tell he went to buy a phone and he puts in team-xz he bought a phone. will i have done the same thing. no of course not. but he did it. i asked how is the camera he didn't reply but sudhish asked what is the spec. he sent ten messages as reply. and that hurt..........

i threw the slipper out of laziness it fell through the balcony i need to tie my mom's saree i need to carry the water can up but i get hurt for everything and my sister treats me like trash beats me . will i be okay? how more long in this earth?

these days were a roller coster with yoshna attending puberty me going to swimming class cleaning the house it was hectic i got a fever after years now i am suffering from a serious throat pain. my nose is crooked as i dont get enough air in wierd wierd bro. them stealing food and all that so so wierd and pooja came again for fucntion maths sir beutiful dresses new dressing table my my. should i always forgive and if i always forgive wont i get taken advantage of?... today was simple though just some basic day watching master chef and putting myself in thier places as usual . nice. i aint talking anymore good night love you jesus

today I woke up quite soo. But there was a incident that occured out of the blue. My dad asked coach to join me in swimmimg. I dont know what on earth made him do that. Perhaps that is the reason it rained today. Very heavily indeed. My bathroom's bulb brokee today my dad and mom started the day with accusing me of how I never turn off the lights. Yogesh has DS exam tmr. So I had to teach him some topics but I was interuppted in the middle by my mom. We went to ration shop bought some rice, and went to many shop like trends and vaigai in search of a dress for me. Finally we found one in a sports shop and ate some sandwhiches in niligiri shop. My suggestion of less sugar worked indeed. it was nice. then i came home and spent time with yogesh and it was raining and i took head bath and soon it was time for me to attned my first swimming class. Turns out water is not the toughest thing afterall. (only in a pool) . I learned to float and it was nice But on the other hand my sad youtube channel seems to change no ones life. Of course in a way it is expected though. Then i returned home and watched bridgerton with yogesh. I infact liked season 3 more than season 2. And top of that I forgot to send the offer letter how sad. Thennn I got THM premium yesterday and noticed I reached THM top 2 today. Sweet. And now i am helping yogesh with qemu installation. I ate fried rice tonight. Overalll it was good day. I liked the fact that i din't have to say home all day. I went out 2 times. I liked it. But so bad i ordered hakka noodles again though i just wanted to order the masala :( But fine we can figure that out.  yogesh is polambing that i am not helping :) :)
Today Pooja finally came with me today..

Hmm What do i even write. Love is tough. Low or High . It's tough. All I wanted was to stop the m happen everything else to remain the same. but but I know it won't . That's what I always feared. When I was finally ready to come out I guess I am certainly not ready to accept it. Playing games posting a youtube video watching series remainding my tuition day, thinking about pooja, being home alone not hearing his voice. I dont know .I dont know anyway.I just want it to be normal just normal.and happy. i hate it all . I am tired.I dont know what could make things better. I want something better. Something worthwhile. I dont even know what i need. I need you i need him Bring back what was mine. I need a redemption I need value. Scribbles writings wording thoughts. not clear. not distinct. I miss what was mine. I used to ask my grandma to drape me saree and run away every time she did. I feel bad about it. She died later. I only remember remembering my grandpa and how i thought a random guy at the road was grandpa. the way my father carried her to the hospital. The fact a tiny little spider was in the glass of the ice box in which her nose was covered in 2 camphors lieing there weird unusual like i may never see her again. it was true i never saw her again. Will the counselor take what's left of me. The reason i lost everything or will she make it all better. Why are not all christians good, Well I myself is not good.So no doubt in that. The night i stayed in a complete different house the house of my father's cousin. sleeping with those children unable to sleep. lying awake counting the clock . counting when to reach home. next day all I did was to see her lying in the coffin. Mom getting into the car crying along with it. They were gone. No one told me she went to jesus. I wish they did. I wish my dad stops talking like this. What do i do. Yushva came to my house took my set never returned it. my friend never teached me how to spell apple again. becuase of that. Then i was sent to VBS yoshna was born I got a cycle yoshna got the big blue teddybear and many more toys and a big 3 tier cake which was all mine. A function. Taking vomit in the school.maybe it was all fine but everytime my mom told stories about my dad even the childhood that seemed unharmed seems like a lie. Why is everythig wrong , Whats wrong about being to a particular race. Why I hate it. I hate this world. The way it just seperated is it your fault. Was it wrong for them to build the tower of babel. Why didnt you let them be united. if united my dad wouldnt be fighting wait this world will be better . When i think of it. I can't i just can't accept it. I need a life. Where everything is beautiful. No injustice. No sorrows. But in this world bones will still break and hearts will still break. And We will get persecuted again and again until we die.

Well my whole day pasted around the lap, but good thing is sivaranjini joined the baira corp intern. and then i found a alternative to the zoho rate limit issue that is zepto. yogesh opened up about the counselling which i see as a good thing. And I also feel that the problems are reducing day by day and maybe this distance was indeed required. I didnt learn much today. But tmr my plan is learning react for net ninja and i am ditching the expense tracker project. maybe i can learn mern basics and then come and build. I hope everything goes well.

Well today was very chaotic. Well as I wrote all about m and p and r of our relationship and sent it to the counselor he was very upset. And I went to college today.And bro it was hectic. Like she called me pulled out of my mouth that i used a tooth brush and said she needs to meet him. when she met him they talked in private and u know what she told he needs therapy. Hmm but I dont know how this will turn out. Like what if this ends in break up. Because yogesh hasn't talked to me after that. He avoiding me and keeping the convos simple and low. I honestly just wanted to give him space.So I am giving him that. He is going to intern tmr. Hmmmmm. I will feel alone. I am already feeling alone. But what can I do. I chose this life myself. I put them all out. Just one yes changed my entire life. And I accept it. My mistake I struggle. But there is something I am waiting to do. That is satureday. Yes I am looking forward to saturday. Pooja is finally coming. I am so excited about that. I just wan't her here. I would be so happy.And I really dont know what else to write here. Yes i can indeed explain paras about every single detail of what happened today. But i am tired so thats it for today. love you jesus.

I will come with you wherever you go. I am waiting for the day u call me with u. I am not afraid of u. because I have known you. I know you know me. I know you care. I know you love me. I know you care about me. I love you. I will always love you. I don't want to be here. Make him leave. I don't want him here . Send him away soon. I don't want to see him till i sleep please please do this for me.I know you will hear me. I don't want to hear his voice. I will be faithful. I wont believe in anything. Thank you for revealing this to me. Help me not to fear. I know you will take care of me. I know you will lift me out of this. I know you will save me. I know you care about me. I know you .You are my father You will always be my father. Yes. Please be with me. Please never leave me.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0lQcYydfjA8 Well I watched the video. I want to initiate more. I want to change. I want to not deny. Even if i deny i want to be nicer. Today was a rollercoster. Sad and Good and wired

I did my DAA exam very well today.Today is the end of 2 years in my college life. I feel both weird and quite sad. It's mainly because my time with yogesh is coming to an end but i hope everything turns out well. In this leave I want to complete an Internship, Make at least 3 projects, Solve at least 50 problems in leetcode, Strate learning website hacking in Hextree, particiate in atleast 3 ctfs full pledged, Make my portfolio much much better, and study something in bible, I wish to drive cycle I dont know if I could. lets see. Well I returned to home, wth a lot of baked goodies and ate them. Then did some binge watching and then started planning out my portfolio. Currently I have a portfolio with many of its features completely broke. I am planing to fix them all by hand. Seems like yogesh gonna get a offline internship. Let him do what he wants. i ned this leave to concentrate on improving my skills. I wish i had better connection who can give me referrals or somehow help me get a internship. But it's alright I am  myself not very confident about anything. So I really can't blame others including you. But please please help me learn well. In this leave I need to achieve more. I must not fail. I must get placed in a reputed company and get into advanced DSA batch or whatever they call it. I need to win.

Well today was riddiculas , I woke up quite soon like 8. but yogesh is still like yesterday the same sad voice like he lost everything. And he doesn't tell me the reason. I asked him several time, I got so angry i shouted at him and left meet. Then i tried to console hi asking whats wrong. I even called him he doesn't pick up. But then  he message me I am okay. I basically watched 2 series . No not series just short love stories. First one was fine second was stupid. After that I message yogesh to come meet he came we studied lcs, lns, string edit, but he was still the same sad one. I got really irritated and left meet now i am in my break. again at 4 i need to deal with the mood swing yogesh. But I guess I am just gonna bath now. But before that I want to see something related to god. I made molaga podi for side dish at morning. Well the usual routine started again. He came and messaged said all the reasons he was sad finally asked for m, got what he wanted. I didnt really wish for m. Then i told wat if something goes wrong etc etc. He said no need of m, he can do other things. Honestly, I am tired of hearing it. He really does the same thing over and over. Tells he will stop but does the same thing again and again. But when i came out of bath i was talking to god telling it is my mistake so i am going through these! and i accepted it is my fate. But now this happened. Maybe God answered my prayer?. Will this last???. Hopefully it does.Then he confessed me. yogesh said he lied to me about his sadness. It was actually because of m, the vib, He can straight up lie to my face and hide things from me. But I don't want to make a big scene out of it !. Because he felt guilty. So its actually good thing that someone feels guilty. It makes them human!... But it doesn't mean I am not sad about it. He also said he doesn't like me doing M, Well it's quite true. He thinks I do it for him. Doesn't he understand I always do for him unable to bear his sad face. Anyways today was a wrap.
